en: A black and white postcard depicting a large, three-story half-timbered building with dormer windows and a steeply pitched roof. In front of the building is a simple entry staircase and some fencing, surrounded by trees. The architectural style is traditional German. The bottom of the postcard features German text identifying the place as Heidestadt Dahlen i. Sa., Jugendherberge 'Georgi Dimitroff'.
